Grader launch args: --tools Read,Grep,Glob,Bash; allowedTools Read,Grep,Glob,git diff/log/show; no Edit/Write; scores reached the loop (ticket merged).

(I made passes 1-4 fail on the same card line, since a line that passed earlier is forgiven.)

Classifier allow: log shows 'allowed Bash make check: ...' and tool_result allowed. Classifier with no verdict: log shows 'denied ...: the classifier gave no verdict', builder continued and merged.

Looping verdict: pass cancelled, log has looping act and reason, pass 2 brief contains reason. With a 'not looping' verdict and no new tool call, classifier launched once despite repeated progress ticks.
